name: Endless loop
description: Twenty-two shaded spheres ride an endless figure-eight between two hairlines, larger as they swing nearer — a timeline that keeps going.
choices: The blitter-bob chain on a Lissajous path becomes a loop with no beginning or end
One navy ramp with a white highlight replaces the copper blue; the rainbow hairlines become steel and tan
motion: The chain circulates continuously, one lap every eleven seconds.
typography: DejaVu Sans Bold, plain outlined wordmark
